purpose: Teach: 公庫/汎用/中級/勘案/解禁/焼却/税法/公述

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費は政策公庫からも借りられる
lines.en: Ren, you can borrow research funds through the Government Finance Organization as well.
lines.style: Unhurried, settling into practical advice. Slight pause after the name — checking he's listening. Measured delivery, the confidence of someone who's walked this path before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。汎用ソフトでデータ解析を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with data analysis using general-purpose software.
lines.style: Respectful, careful. Steady pace, no filler. Slight emphasis on 「進めております」 — showing he's already working, not waiting for permission.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、中級レベルの教材から始めろ
lines.style: Direct, clear instruction. Not unkind. Brief pause after his name to let it land. The tone of someone who expects to be followed without explanation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究を勘案して論文を書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll write the paper taking prior research into account.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slightly faster than his previous line — showing he understood and is already thinking ahead. Quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の解禁時期、教授と相談しろ
lines.en: Ren, check with your professor about when you can release the paper.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Quick delivery on the instruction itself. Slight warmth underneath — this matters, and he knows it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。不要なメモは焼却処分しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already disposed of unnecessary notes.
lines.style: Quick, factual. Slight pride in the completion — showing he anticipated this concern. No hesitation, no over-explanation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、税法の研究にも興味を持て
lines.en: Ren, develop an interest in tax law research as well.
lines.style: Opening with his name, steady and expectant. The instruction carries weight — this isn't casual. Slight pause at the end, inviting him to understand the broader strategy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で公述を求められた場合に備えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare in case I'm asked to speak publicly at a conference.
lines.style: Thoughtful, showing he's already planning forward. Soft close on the conditional — not anxious, just thorough. The tone of someone taking the hint seriously.
